headline:
A better day
starts at home.
intro: Cooling that keeps up. Heating you can count on. Understand your options and find the right next step for your home.
serviceTitle: Comfort, from the first visit onward.
serviceIntro: Choose the kind of help you need. The right recommendation starts with understanding the system, the space, and the problem.

offers.title: Get it working
offers.text: A focused diagnostic visit for rooms that will not cool, unusual cycling, or a system that has stopped.

offers.title: Plan what comes next
offers.text: Explore replacement when comfort, system age, and operating needs no longer line up.

offers.title: Keep a good thing going
offers.text: A planned check-in for the equipment you already have.

story.eyebrow: KNOW WHAT YOU’RE SAYING YES TO
story.title: A clear explanation is part of the service.
story.text: A noisy system is a symptom, not a diagnosis. A useful visit connects what you are noticing to what is happening—and lays out the choices in plain language.
points: A conversation about the rooms you use

guide.title: Start with what you notice.
guide.intro: You do not need to know the name of the part. A few observations can help the first conversation.

notes.title: Uneven rooms
notes.text: Note which rooms feel different and at what time of day. Share whether doors are usually closed and whether the issue is new or longstanding.

notes.title: Airflow and filters
notes.text: Have your equipment model and filter size ready if accessible. Follow manufacturer guidance; do not remove panels or work on electrical components to collect details.

notes.title: Repair or replace?
notes.text: A business should consider diagnosis, equipment condition, household priorities, and available options. A website should help you prepare for that conversation, not guess the answer.

notes.title: Before a scheduled visit
notes.text: Make the thermostat and equipment area accessible. Keep pets comfortable in a separate area and write down when the issue first appeared.

faq.q: Do I need to know what is broken?
faq.a: No. Explain what changed, where you notice it, and how long it has been happening. The appointment preview starts with those everyday observations.

faq.q: Is this an emergency service line?
faq.a: No. This is a fictional business demonstration, and requests are not monitored. For an immediate hazard, contact the appropriate local emergency service.

faq.q: Will this give me a repair price?
faq.a: A real repair quote depends on diagnosis and approved scope. This demo creates a service brief and does not invent a guaranteed repair price.

flow.title: Let’s find your next step.
flow.intro: Tell us what your home needs and preview a service visit.

steps.intro: Start with the reason for your visit.

steps.intro: A little context helps the conversation.
